title: Reporting
content_data:
You can use Reporting API to run a report on your ads data.

This group consists of the following endpoints:
* [Run an Upgraded Smart+ Creative Overview Report](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317489576961)
* [Run an Upgraded Smart+ Creative Breakdown Report](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843317510389761)

seo_description: Find the available endpoints for Upgraded Smart+ Reporting API. Integrating with the correct endpoint helps you get the task done right.
